what: Plan falls back or appends raw tagged finding blocks without a final heading renumber step
scenario_or_breakage: Reviewer fragments start numbering at FINDING_1 per reviewer, and the tally splitter rejects duplicate headings. The proposed pre-dedup parity fallback and plan-mode aggregation append tagged blocks verbatim, so a marker-preservation fallback can turn into tally-error instead of a ballot.
suggested_fix: When bypassing dedup or composing tagged plus aggregated output, run one final sequential renumber over all FINDING and OOS headings and validate uniqueness before writing the ballot. Do not preserve verbatim IDs.
